# DipolarCoupling

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
Long-range anisotropic interaction between magnetic dipoles that mediates spin transport in dilute networks. Key physical mechanism for designing topology-dependent in-network neuromorphic devices using magnetic dipole interactions.
